questions.stem_markdown: A car travels along a straight road with constant acceleration \(a\text{ m s}^{-2}\), where \(a>0\). The car passes through points \(A\), \(B\) and \(C\) in that order. The speed of the car at \(A\) is \(u\text{ m s}^{-1}\) in the direction \(AB\). The distance \(BC\) is twice the distance \(AB\). The car takes 8 seconds to travel from \(A\) to \(B\) and 10 seconds to travel from \(B\) to \(C\).

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: $$AB : [s =] u \times 8 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 8^2$$ $$[= 8u + 32a] \text{ or } \frac{u + u + 8a}{2} \times 8$$ $$BC : [2s =] (u + 8a) \times 10 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 10^2 \quad [= 10u + 130a]$$ or $$\frac{u + 8a + u + 8a + 10a}{2} \times 10$$ $$AC : [3s =] u \times 18 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 18^2$$ $$[= 18u + 162a] \text{ or } \frac{u + u + 18a}{2} \times 18$$
mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: For use of $$s = ut + \frac{1}{2} at^2$$ or $$s = \frac{u + v}{2} t$$. B1 for any one correct expression, B2 for two correct expressions.

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: Attempt to solve simultaneously $$(u + 8a) \times 10 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 10^2 = 2 \left( u \times 8 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 8^2 \right)$$ $$[\Rightarrow 10u + 130a = 2(8u + 32a)]$$ OR $$u \times 18 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 18^2 = 3 \left( u \times 8 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 8^2 \right)$$ $$[\Rightarrow 18u + 162a = 3(8u + 32a)]$$ $$u \times 18 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 18^2 = \frac{3}{2} \left( (u + 8a) \times 10 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 10^2 \right)$$ $$[\Rightarrow 18u + 162a = \frac{3}{2} (10u + 130a)]$$
mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: To obtain an equation in $$u$$ and $$a$$ only. Must have come from correct expressions but allow $$\times \frac{1}{3}$$ instead of $$\times 3$$ or $$\times \frac{1}{2}$$ instead of $$\times 2$$ or $$\times \frac{2}{3}$$ instead of $$\times \frac{3}{2}$$. Note: M0 for $$u \times 10 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 10^2 = 2 \left( u \times 8 + \frac{1}{2} a \times 8^2 \right)$$ leading to $$u = -\frac{7}{3} a$$. Note: M0 for distance $$AC = 2AB$$ leading to $$u = -49a$$.
B1 for any one correct expression, B2 for two correct expressions.
To obtain an equation in $$u$$ and $$a$$ only.

For use of $$v = u + at$$ or other complete suvat method Using *their* $$u$$ in terms of $$a$$, e.g. $$v^2 = (11a)^2 + 2a(18 \times 11a + 162a) \left[ = 841a^2 \right]$$, $$v = \sqrt{(11a)^2 + 2a(18 \times 11a + 162a)} \left[ = \sqrt{841a^2} \right]$$.

questions.stem_markdown: A particle travels in a straight line. The velocity of the particle at time \(t\) s after leaving a point \(O\) is \(v\text{ m s}^{-1}\), where \(v = kt^2 - 4t + 3\). For attempt at differentiation. Must have expression of the form $$at + b$$ with $$a \neq 3$$, unless their $$k = \frac{3}{2}$$. Allow $$2kt - 4$$.
OE FT their $$k$$ $$t = \frac{2}{\text{their } k}$$. Allow without working.
OE Allow 1.67 or better for $$v$$.
Must have $$\left( t - \frac{2}{3} \right)^2$$ OE, or $$\left( t - \frac{2}{\text{their } k} \right)^2$$.
FT their $$k$$ $$k \left( t - \frac{2}{k} \right)^2 - \frac{4}{k} + 3$$.

parts.prompt_markdown: It is given that the tension in the tow-bar is 450 N. Find the acceleration of the trailer and the driving force of the van's engine.

SUVAT for motion under constant acceleration
subtopics: Dynamics of two bodies connected by a tow-bar
